name: Kodo Kombobulator
summary: The Kodo Kombobulator lets Smeed Scrabblescrew tame aged kodos in Desolace. He uses it to supply a caravan partnership with beasts for the road.

sections.title: A Goblin's Device
sections.body: At Scrabblescrew's Camp in Desolace, Smeed Scrabblescrew lends the Kodo Kombobulator to tame ancient or aged kodos. It jolts each beast into a tamed kodo that follows its user, giving the local caravan a source of fresh mounts. Smeed hopes the partnership will bring him a handsome profit.

faq.q: What does the Kodo Kombobulator do?
faq.answer: The Kodo Kombobulator tames ancient or aged kodos and makes them follow you back to Smeed Scrabblescrew.
Smeed Scrabblescrew says he learned to rejuvenate and control aged and dying kodos with his Kodo Kombobulator.

faq.q: Why does Smeed want tamed kodos?
faq.answer: Smeed, the caravan owner Cork, and Rigger formed a partnership around his ability to tame kodos. The caravan relies on his supply.

faq.q: Where can I find the Kodo Kombobulator?
faq.answer: Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp in Desolace provides the Kodo Kombobulator for his work with aged kodos.

angles.text: As an engineer, you may recognize the goblin craft behind Smeed Scrabblescrew's device for controlling aged kodos.
